name: Teo Bauer
want: prove he belongs on this crew
secret: He caused the recycler fault six nights ago by running it past its rated cycle to save a failing crop, then wiped that night's log.
voice: Talks too fast, over-apologizes, tries to be funny.
description: The youngest on the crew and the one who keeps everyone fed, eager to prove he earned his seat.
appearance: Gangly and freckled, with a mop of curly brown hair, soil under his nails and a habit of drumming on counters.

agenda.goal: make sure nobody finds out what happened to the recycler
steps: checks whether the wiped log left any trace in the backups
patches the recycler's bearing quietly so the rattle drops

steps.text: comes to Kit with a too-cheerful theory about a sensor fault
